items.title: perf: Overhaul `_cmpkey` to remove use of custom objects

verdicts.label: likely-bug
verdicts.rationale: The PR removes the `_structures` module and its `Infinity`/`NegativeInfinity` sentinel classes, which were used in the comparison key (`_cmpkey`) of `Version` objects. Pickled `Version` objects from the old version may contain references to these sentinel classes in their cached `_key_cache`. Unpickling them in the new version fails with `ModuleNotFoundError` because the module no longer exists. This is an unintended regression for users who rely on pickling `Version` objects across versions; the PR presents itself as a performance refactor and does not mention pickling compatibility in tests,
